snippet.title: Bowling - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
One of many shovelware games from Sabec Limited, the same company who made the terrible 3D remake of the Popeye arcade game.

The aim of the game is to score points by knocking down the pins, just line up your shot by choosing the position, power and direction of your ball.

Also available on Nintendo Switch.

FUN FACT: As of April 8th, 2025, the official user ratings are sitting at 2.71 out of 5 overall according the game's PlayStation Store page, with 279 user ratings altogether. 44% gave it 1-star ratings, while 32% gave it 5-stars.
